build_CLIP_model: build a CLIP model with custom vision and text config dataclasses for multimodal embedding
build_model_from_openai_state_dict: build a CLIP model from an OpenAI pretrained state dict with auto-detected architecture
encode_image_CLIP: encode an image tensor into normalized features using the CLIP model visual encoder
encode_text_CLIP: encode text tokens into normalized features using the CLIP model text transformer
trace_model: trace a CLIP model with example inputs for TorchScript export and deployment
